title: Roasted Cauliflower Tacos
description: A delicious and easy Mexican-inspired dish featuring roasted cauliflower in a flavorful taco.
instructions: Rinse the cauliflower and remove the leaves and stem.
In a large bowl, mix together the oregano, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Add the cauliflower to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat.
Spread the cauliflower on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the roasted cauliflower onto a tortilla and topping with cheese.
